title: THE LUCIE-7B LLM AND THE LUCIE TRAINING DATASET: OPEN RESOURCES FOR MULTILINGUAL LANGUAGE GENERATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model performance across multiple languages (English, French, Spanish, German, Italian) on standard NLP benchmarks (such as ARC Challenge, HellaSwag, and MMLU) to assess the mitigation of English-centered pretraining disparities, though the authors note that using translated benchmarks limits the ability to evaluate deeper cultural nuances.
